_README: Where a cited file actually lives, when it is not in this repository. Checked by hand against the live repositories on 2026-10-30; record_links.py reads this and reports EXTERNAL or HISTORICAL instead of MISSING. Every entry carries the evidence used to decide it. Nothing is listed here because it was convenient — a wrong entry hides a real loss.

state/canon.json.why: The Control Centre's ring_ages table. Cited by CANON_NOTES as the source of the year-ring colours; it was never lan_shen's file.

state/laws.json.why: The Control Centre's twelve locks. Cited by SERIAL_LOG while describing the site's own state, not this serial's.

state/projects_registry.json.why: The Control Centre's project registry. Cited by SERIAL_LOG as the place that names lan_shen live at Chapter 13.

extract_state.py.why: The Control Centre's measuring instrument. SERIAL_LOG says so in as many words: 'It is their instrument, in their [repository]'.

scripts/drift.py.why: The StoryOS drift scanner — the tool that deliberately does not trust the project's own validator.

storyos-site/scripts/drift.py.why: Same file, cited with its repository prefix.

TRANSFER_BOOTSTRAP.txt.why: Cited inside SERIAL_LOG's historical table describing what the standalone lan_shen repository's bootstrap kit gave in September 2026. That repository was deleted in the 2026-10-12 consolidation; this is a record of what it contained, not a dependency.

fix/RUN_ME.md.why: Same table — the source of the TWO-COPIES LAW, the en-dash regex and the 'a number written to satisfy a check is worse than a warning left honest' line. All of that law is already carried in this project's own files; the file it came from is history.

uploads/chapter_75.md.why: Same table — the author's own prose, named as the quality bar. Preserved in the kit at SL1_GU_YUAN/uploads/; see that path for the surviving copy.

REFERENCE_MAP.md.why: The deleted repository's own map. Its content is summarised in SERIAL_LOG and STYLE_LAW §0.5.

PROTOCOL.md.why: Exists in this repository's history (13 commits) though not at HEAD. Recover with `git log --all -- PROTOCOL.md`.

foundation/PREWRITE_ch04_draft_block.md.what: The canon-006 staging draft, 1,894 words, authored 2026-09-23 — described by PREWRITE_ch04 as 'the raw body to re-voice and reassemble' for the shipped Chapter 4.
foundation/PREWRITE_ch04_draft_block.md.evidence: Absent from the working tree; absent from all 335 commits; absent from the 478-file one-home archive (whose lan_shen_v1_epoch holds 18 files and no draft block). It has never existed in this repository.
foundation/PREWRITE_ch04_draft_block.md.likely_home: The standalone lan_shen repository, deleted in the 2026-10-12 consolidation, or a working machine that was never committed.
foundation/PREWRITE_ch04_draft_block.md.impact: None on the shipped chapter: chapter 4 was re-voiced from canon 006 directly and passed every gate (verify, style, canon_copy, banned). What is lost is the evidence trail — a reader cannot check the board's claim that a 1,894-word draft existed, and cannot compare the V2 chapter against the thing it was rebuilt from.
foundation/PREWRITE_ch04_draft_block.md.author_decision: Either the draft is restored from GitHub's deleted-repository window (around 2027-01-10) or a working machine, or the board is amended to say the draft did not survive and the chapter was built from canon alone.
foundation/PREWRITE_ch04_draft_block.md.status: KNOWN LOSS — recorded, not repaired. Listed here so the gate fails on NEW breakage and not on a finding already written down.
